# Science [color=#c96dbf]Science[/color] recovers lost technology. The sector's lathes still remember the basics, the [color=#a4885c]Inherited Codex[/color]. Everything past that was lost in the Corporate War, and its pieces lie scattered across the worlds as [color=#d070ff]pattern shards[/color].
## The R&D console
The R&D server stores what your ship knows. The R&D console is where you plan hunts, decode shards and unlock what you bring home.
- The [color=#a4885c]Codex[/color] tab shows your server's technology tree. Green nodes are known. Amber nodes can be hunted now. Red nodes need their prerequisites first. - The [color=#a4885c]Relics[/color] tab lists lost items that sit outside the tree.
Every server starts with all of its tier-1 technology. Everything else has to be found.
## Hunting a pattern 1. Pick up to four patterns of the same tier and add them to the request. 2. Press [color=#a4885c]Locate[/color] and pay the fee. The console marks a planet site that suits the tier and reveals its signal. 3. Fly there and search its crates and lockers for the shards. Higher tiers send you to more dangerous worlds. 4. Use each shard on any powered R&D console to decode it into a [color=#d070ff]Blueprint Construct[/color]. 5. Use the Construct on the console. Its technology or relic unlocks on that server until the round ends.
Shards and Constructs are ordinary items. Anyone can carry, steal or trade them, and a Construct works on any server that can use it.
- [color=#6fbf73]Tier I, Recovered[/color]: Moderate worlds, 5,000 fee. - [color=#e0b040]Tier II, Lost[/color]: Hazardous worlds, 15,000 fee. - [color=#d070ff]Tier III, Forgotten[/color]: Extreme worlds, 40,000 fee.
## Paying for hunts The fee comes out of your server's [color=#a4885c]research points[/color] first and your bank account after. Nothing makes points on its own. You earn them by doing science: - analysing artifacts - containing anomalies with a vessel - xenobiology bounties - research disks found in the field
## Decoding arrays
Each powered decoding array linked to your server makes its consoles decode shards faster, down to under half the time.
## Lathes
Link a lathe to your server to print what it knows. Recipes need materials, which come from miners and salvagers.
